The Israel Defense Forces says they have launched strikes in southern Lebanon after alleged ceasefire violations by Hezbollah.

events.topic: War on drugs, Illegal drug trade in Latin America, Crime in Spain
events.text: The Spanish Civil Guard and the Ecuadorian National Police announce they have arrested 44 people and confiscated 21 tons of cocaine as part of a multiyear investigation on a drug trafficking ring financed by investors in Dubai.
A drone loaded with explosives is found and defused at Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany, while a cargo Boeing 757 had a collision with another supposed UAV at the same airport.
Progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed defeats U.S. Rep. Haley Stevens in the primary for the upcoming U.S. Senate election in Michigan.

events.topic: Pastoral trips made by Pope Leo XIV
